title: People NFT Collection
tagline: A different People NFTs Collection Avatars, people like old, young etc..
description: This project is collection of different people NFTs. There are variety of people age like young, old etc.. some stars also will smith, Habibi, Steve Jobs, old grandma etc... The NFT are in avatars form. We have made collection of 15 NFTs on OpenSea were you  can  see  the  NFTs .
how_its_made:
This project use NFTPort API to deploy contract, Mint NFT,  Upload Metadata, Upload to IPFS etc... All the images and metadata store on IPFS using third party Pinata service. We have also use polygon to deploy the NFTs collection.
The main sponsors technology we use is NFTPort & second Filecoin for Storage.
